timeline.summary: FDC Limited’s Board approved seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot for Mr. Kishore Saletore’s appointment as Independent Director, effective April 1, 2026.
On April 3, 2026, FDC promoters disclosed zero share encumbrance and a 69.66% holding as of March 31, 2026.
On May 18, 2026, FDC Limited announced receiving USFDA ANDA approval for Cefixime for Oral Suspension USP.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹584.79 Cr (+18.9% YoY), net profit ₹103.4 Cr (+167.4% YoY).
FDC Limited reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹585 Cr (+18.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹103 Cr (+167.4% YoY).
FDC Limited’s shareholders approved Mr. Kishore Mukund Saletore (DIN: 01705850) as Independent Director via Postal Ballot on May 27, 2026, with 99.77% voting in favor.
FDC's depot stock of Enerzal seized by Maharashtra FDA for alleged misbranding
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹572.14 Cr (+21.0% YoY), net profit ₹49.06 Cr (+72.9% YoY).
FDC Limited board approved a share buyback of up to 24,00,000 equity shares for ₹120 Cr at ₹500 per share via tender offer route, with November 13, 2026 as the record date.
FDC published public announcement for ₹120 Cr share buyback at ₹500/share via tender offer with November 13, 2026 as record date.
FDC received favorable tax appeal orders for AY 2014-15 and AY 2012-13, resulting in an aggregate tax refund of ₹37.22 Cr.
